state: Actual short-selector checks for nine registered root records: 81 states, 18 texts and 63 English fallbacks. Nine STAR/Salmon fallbacks use the corrected canonical lead; no stored text, long cache or review mark changed. No native-language acceptance.

records.name: Bulk RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) and the full transcriptome (es)
TPM, FPKM and raw counts (expression units) (es)
Gene fusion (es)
records.text: Una fusión génica une secuencias de genes distintos. Su producto de ARN, sus efectos sobre la proteína y su relevancia para el tratamiento requieren evidencia específica para cada uno.

records.name: RNA splicing (es)
records.text: Los genes se cortan y pegan en mensajes antes de ser utilizados. Los cánceres de la sangre suelen tener mutaciones en la maquinaria de empalme, y los errores crean proteínas anormales que podrían servir como dianas o señales inmunitarias.

records.name: STAR and Salmon (RNA-seq alignment and quantification) (es)
Bulk RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) and the full transcriptome (zh)
TPM, FPKM and raw counts (expression units) (zh)
Gene fusion (zh)
records.text: 基因融合把不同基因的序列连接起来。它的 RNA 产物、对蛋白质的影响和治疗意义，都需要各自的证据支持。

records.name: RNA splicing (zh)
records.text: 基因在被使用之前会被剪切并拼接成信息。血液癌症常常携带剪接机器的突变，这些错误产生的异常蛋白可能成为治疗靶点或免疫标记。

records.name: STAR and Salmon (RNA-seq alignment and quantification) (zh)
Bulk RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) and the full transcriptome (pt)
TPM, FPKM and raw counts (expression units) (pt)
Gene fusion (pt)
records.text: Uma fusão gênica une sequências de genes diferentes. O produto de RNA, os efeitos sobre a proteína e a relevância para o tratamento exigem evidências específicas para cada um.

records.name: RNA splicing (pt)
records.text: Os genes são cortados e colados em mensagens antes de serem usados. Cânceres do sangue frequentemente carregam mutações na maquinaria de splicing, e os erros criam proteínas anormais que poderiam servir como alvos ou sinalizadores imunes.

records.name: STAR and Salmon (RNA-seq alignment and quantification) (pt)
Bulk RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) and the full transcriptome (hi)
TPM, FPKM and raw counts (expression units) (hi)
Gene fusion (hi)
records.text: जीन संलयन में विभिन्न जीनों के अनुक्रम जुड़ते हैं। इसके आरएनए उत्पाद, प्रोटीन पर प्रभाव और उपचार में महत्व के लिए अलग प्रमाण आवश्यक हैं।

records.name: RNA splicing (hi)
records.text: जीनों को उपयोग में लाने से पहले काट-जोड़ कर संदेशों में बदला जाता है। रक्त कैंसरों में अक्सर स्प्लाइसिंग तंत्र में उत्परिवर्तन होते हैं, और इन त्रुटियों से असामान्य प्रोटीन बनते हैं जो लक्ष्य या प्रतिरक्षा संकेतक के रूप में काम आ सकते हैं।

records.name: STAR and Salmon (RNA-seq alignment and quantification) (hi)
Bulk RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) and the full transcriptome (fr)
TPM, FPKM and raw counts (expression units) (fr)
Gene fusion (fr)
records.text: Une fusion de gènes relie des séquences de gènes différents. Le produit en ARN, les effets sur la protéine et l’intérêt pour le traitement doivent être évalués séparément, à partir de preuves adaptées.

records.name: RNA splicing (fr)
records.text: Les gènes sont découpés et recollés en messages avant d'être utilisés. Les cancers du sang portent souvent des mutations de la machinerie d'épissage, et les erreurs créent des protéines anormales qui pourraient servir de cibles ou de signaux pour le système immunitaire.

records.name: STAR and Salmon (RNA-seq alignment and quantification) (fr)
Bulk RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) and the full transcriptome (de)
TPM, FPKM and raw counts (expression units) (de)
Gene fusion (de)
records.text: Eine Genfusion verbindet Sequenzen verschiedener Gene. Das RNA-Produkt, die Folgen für das Protein und die Bedeutung für eine Behandlung brauchen jeweils eigene Belege.

records.name: RNA splicing (de)
records.text: Gene werden zerschnitten und zu Botschaften zusammengefügt, bevor sie genutzt werden. Blutkrebsarten tragen häufig Mutationen in der Spleißmaschinerie, und die Fehler erzeugen abnorme Proteine, die als Zielstrukturen oder Immunmarker dienen könnten.

records.name: STAR and Salmon (RNA-seq alignment and quantification) (de)
Bulk RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) and the full transcriptome (ja)
TPM, FPKM and raw counts (expression units) (ja)
Gene fusion (ja)
records.text: 遺伝子融合では、異なる遺伝子の配列がつながります。RNA産物やタンパク質への影響、治療上の意味は、それぞれ根拠を確かめる必要があります。

records.name: RNA splicing (ja)
records.text: 遺伝子は使われる前に切り貼りされてメッセージになる。血液がんはスプライシング機構の変異をもつことが多く、その誤りから生じる異常なタンパク質は治療標的や免疫の目印になり得る。

records.name: STAR and Salmon (RNA-seq alignment and quantification) (ja)
Bulk RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) and the full transcriptome (ar)
TPM, FPKM and raw counts (expression units) (ar)
Gene fusion (ar)
records.text: الاندماج الجيني يربط تسلسلات من جينات مختلفة. ويتطلب تحديد ناتج الحمض النووي الريبي، وأثر الاندماج على البروتين، وأهميته للعلاج أدلة خاصة بكل منها.

records.name: RNA splicing (ar)
records.text: تُقطع الجينات وتُلصق في رسائل قبل استخدامها. وكثيراً ما تحمل سرطانات الدم طفرات في آلية التضفير، وتنتج الأخطاء بروتينات غير طبيعية يمكن أن تكون أهدافاً علاجية أو علامات مناعية.

records.name: STAR and Salmon (RNA-seq alignment and quantification) (ar)
Bulk RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) and the full transcriptome (simple)
TPM, FPKM and raw counts (expression units) (simple)
Gene fusion (simple)
records.text: A gene fusion joins parts of different genes. Finding it does not by itself show what protein is made, how it works or whether a treatment will help.

records.name: RNA splicing (simple)
records.text: Genes are cut and pasted into messages before use; blood cancers often carry faults in this splicing machinery, and the errors create abnormal proteins that could serve as targets.

effective.effectiveText: RNA sequencing measures captured RNA messages and, with a suitable library and analysis, can examine transcript joins.
Bulk RNA sequencing measures captured messages pooled across a tissue sample, including contributions from multiple cell types.
A batch effect is a systematic measurement difference associated with how samples were prepared, processed or analysed.
Single-cell and single-nucleus RNA sequencing profile captured messages assigned to recovered cells or nuclei.
RNA count units depend on what was counted, the normalisation denominator and any transcript-length adjustment.
Deconvolution estimates which cell populations contributed to a mixed molecular measurement.
